Fact.Name: ctc8862Required
Fact.Description: Used to indicate whether Part III of Schedule 8862 is applicable

Fact.Name: Received CTC improper claims
Fact.Description: Since 2015 (TY -8?) the IRS has reduced or disallowed the TP or MFJ spouse's CTC, ACTC, or ODC for reasons other than a math error.

Fact.Name: Received CTC improper Claims notice
Fact.Description: Whether the TP received a letter from the IRS telling them they're not allowed to take CTC, ACTC, or ODC for a number of years

Fact.Name: CTC improper claims notice expired
Fact.Description: Whether the improper claims notice that the TP previously received is far enough in the past to be expired. E.g. They could not file for 2 years, and it has been at least 2 years

Fact.Name: CTC Has Filed CTC or ODC since notice expired
Fact.Description: Whether the TP has filed for CTC or ODC again since the notice has expired. The first time a taxpayer files after their notice has expired, they need to fill out form 8862.

Fact.Name: Flow CTC Ask Improper Claims Expiration
Fact.Description: Whether the flow should ask a person if their CTC improper claims notice has expired

Fact.Name: Display value for PDF Schedule 8812, Line 18a
Fact.Description: Earned income with all combat pay if completing Part II-A; undefined otherwise.

Fact.Name: Display value for PDF Schedule 8812, Line 18b

Fact.Name: Display value for PDF Schedule 8812, Line 21
Fact.Description: Social Security taxes withheld if completing Part II-B; undefined otherwise.

Fact.Name: Schedule 8812 line 22 amount
Fact.Description: Schedule 8812 (Form 1040) 2026 draft (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f1040s8--dft.pdf), page 2, Part II-B, line 22: "Enter the total of the amounts from Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 15; Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 16c; and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 17c". 26 U.S.C. 24(d)(2)(A)(ii) counts as social security taxes "50 percent of the taxes imposed by section 1401 on the self-employment income of the taxpayer", which is the 26 U.S.C. 164(f) deduction on Schedule 1 line 15 (income /schedule1Line15 = scheduleSE /deductibleSelfEmploymentTax, the whole-return amount). Schedule 2 line 16c (Forms 4137 and 8919) and line 17c (uncollected tax from W-2 box 12 codes A, B, M and N) are always zero on a supported return: unreported tips stop the return (/flowKnockoutUnreportedTips) and so do those box 12 codes (formW2s /knockoutForBox12Value), so neither is added here.

Fact.Name: Schedule 8812 line 23 amount
Fact.Description: Schedule 8812 (Form 1040) 2026 draft, page 2, Part II-B, line 23: "Add lines 21 and 22". Line 21 is withheld social security, Medicare and Additional Medicare taxes from Form(s) W-2, boxes 4 and 6 (formW2s /socialSecurityTaxesWithheld); line 22 is /actcSelfEmploymentAndOtherTaxes. Together they are the social security taxes of 26 U.S.C. 24(d)(2)(A)(i) and (ii) used for the three-or-more-children amount of 24(d)(1)(B)(ii).

Fact.Name: Display value for PDF Schedule 8812, Line 22
Fact.Description: Schedule 1 line 15 (+ Schedule 2 lines 16c and 17c, zero on a supported return) if completing Part II-B; undefined otherwise.

Fact.Name: Display value for PDF Schedule 8812, Line 23
Fact.Description: Line 21 + line 22 if completing Part II-B; undefined otherwise.

Fact.Name: Display value for PDF Schedule 8812, Line 24
Fact.Description: Earned income credit if completing Part II-B; undefined otherwise.
